summary.intent: Run the GSD manager to discuss all 5 remaining hardening-block phases (51–55) of the v1.1 milestone and kick off planning agents for as many phases as possible in parallel using isolated git worktrees.
summary.outcome: All 5 phases received CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md (committed on their respective branches). Phases 51, 52, and 53 had background planning agents running in isolated worktrees; Phase 51 completed planning with 4 plans passing all gates. Phases 54 and 55 are discussed and ready to plan.

repo: GSD dep parser incorrectly splits 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' into dep 49 + phantom dep '1.1', causing all phases that depend on 49 to read as deps_satisfied:false and producing empty recommended_actions.
Phase 50 had a stale is_active:true flag in the init query output despite being marked [x] completed in ROADMAP and shipped in PR #527 — init query state can lag disk reality.
GSD commit helper can return commit_failed as a false negative; must verify with git log rather than trusting the helper's return value.
The GSD auto-branch behavior triggers on the first phase commit: main → feat/<slug>. Background agents inherit whichever branch the working tree is on at launch time.

core.hooksPath in this repo is an absolute path pointing to the main tree's .husky directory, so worktree commits run the same pre-commit hook (pnpm lint-staged) and require node_modules to be present in the worktree.

Phase 51 scope narrowed during discussion: todo #15 (logger redaction + Faro transport) was dropped entirely — the redaction interceptor has no security value without a remote transport, and its acceptance criteria require Faro to verify. Deferred to a future observability phase.

Phase 53 root-cause analysis: the sdk release-please self-compare loop was caused by a force-push orphaning the bot's release-target commit combined with cancel-in-progress killing the recompute. Stale-pin clearing (#16) is a symptom fix; recompute reliability is the real fix. Pin-clearing machinery dropped from scope.

Phase 55 has a 26-file refactor survey already tiered with per-file split plans. Tier 3 files (several security-sensitive crypto files) have no tests — tests must be written before refactoring those files.

Background agents spawned via Agent(Tools: *) on Claude Code CAN nest sub-agents — the manager workflow's blanket 'no nesting in background on Claude Code' guardrail is stale and overly conservative for this harness.
Two phases cannot safely share one working tree when each auto-switches to its own feat/ branch on first commit — the switch yanks the branch out from under any concurrently running background agent.

code.finding: Canonical path for captured todos is .planning/todos/pending/ — CONTEXT.md initially had a stale reference that needed correction before the planner was relaunched.

Phase 51 scope is S1 (embedded-vs-DTO anti-rollback validation), S2 (fail-closed verification), S3 (exhaustive key zeroization with lint/test guard). S1 embedded-vs-embedded 409 already shipped; only embedded-vs-DTO is open.

Scope: SHA-pin ~111 third-party GHA uses + add Dependabot github-actions ecosystem. Pin-clearing machinery for #16 dropped. Cargo.lock sync prefers native release-please updater with fallback to auto-update-on-PR guard.

7 .mjs helpers to migrate: sdk-core/scripts/{edit-filepointer,rename-folder,verify-filepointer}.mjs, tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/{test-move-content,bump-ipns-sequence}.mjs, tests/web-e2e/staging-perf-wallet.mjs, src-tauri/generate-test-vectors.mjs. Import from package APIs (not ../dist), wire into typecheck+lint, update both run-all.sh and run-all.ps1.

workflow: Worktree isolation is required when running multiple concurrent GSD planning agents — each needs its own git index to prevent index.lock collisions and branch-switching interference.

The correct worktree setup sequence: checkout main in the main tree → git worktree add on the phase's feat/ branch → symlink or install node_modules for hooks → launch agent with RUNTIME_DIR pointing to the worktree.
pnpm i inside the worktree is cleaner than symlinking node_modules from the main tree — gives proper isolated deps with no shared-state leak risk, and hooks run normally.

When a background agent is interrupted by a session limit, check the worktree HEAD and uncommitted state before restarting — pnpm i may already be complete, saving significant startup time on restart.

The GSD plan-phase pipeline (researcher → pattern-mapper → planner → independent plan-checker) can run fully in a background agent on Claude Code when the agent is given Tools: * — the independent checker correctly runs as a nested sub-agent.

friction: Session/usage limit hit mid-session (reset at 8:40pm Berlin), interrupting the Phase 51 background planner after only ~31 seconds — required a manual restart.

Phase 51 planner was initially launched without worktree isolation, running in the shared main working tree and inheriting the feat/crypto-signature branch — required stopping, creating a worktree, and relaunching.
GSD dep parser bug causes all phases depending on 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' to appear blocked, producing empty recommended_actions and requiring manual workaround.
GSD commit helper false-negative on commit_failed forces an extra git log verification step after every commit.
Phase 50's stale is_active:true flag in the init query required manual identification and flagging — the dashboard would have shown it as actively planning.
The manager workflow's Claude Code backgrounding guardrail is incorrect, causing unnecessary debate about whether background agents can nest sub-agents on this runtime.
Worktrees have no node_modules by default; this blocks husky pre-commit hooks, requiring either a pnpm i step or a symlink — not documented in the workflow.
